hook: NFL Exec: Cowboys Should Trade for *Josh Sweat*
dek: Dallas is 2-4 with a stalled pass rush, and an exec says Josh Sweat could fix it.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: The Cowboys are *2-4* after losing to Green Bay, but Jerry Jones' front office isn't done upgrading the defense.

slides.label: The Numbers
slides.text: Dallas ranks 11th in scoring offense but 25th on defense, and sits tied for the *2nd-fewest sacks* in the NFL.

slides.label: The Rumor
slides.text: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports an anonymous NFL exec is urging Dallas to trade for *Cardinals pass-rusher Josh Sweat*.

slides.label: Who He Is
slides.text: Sweat, 29, is a former *Super Bowl champion* and one-time Pro Bowler who requested a trade from Arizona this offseason.

slides.label: The Fit
slides.text: His *2 sacks* this season would already tie Quinnen Williams for the most sacks on the Cowboys roster.

slides.label: Competition
slides.text: Green Bay has also been linked to Sweat, but the Packers now have *Micah Parsons* back on their defense.

slides.label: Status
slides.text: Nothing is done yet. The *Nov. 10 trade deadline* is approaching and Arizona hasn't signaled it will move him.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: Players, many of them Black athletes, generate the value these trades are built on, but have little say in where they end up.

question: Will Dallas pull the trigger before Nov. 10? Yes or no.

caption_instagram:
The Dallas Cowboys are reportedly eyeing a trade for Arizona Cardinals pass-rusher Josh Sweat, according to Sportsnaut. Dallas sits at 2-4, but an anonymous NFL exec told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler that Sweat fits what the Cowboys need up front.

The numbers explain why. Dallas has an 11th-ranked scoring offense paired with a 25th-ranked defense, and they're tied for the second-fewest sacks in the league since trading Micah Parsons. Sweat, 29, is a former Super Bowl champion who asked Arizona for a trade this offseason. His two sacks this year would already tie Quinnen Williams for the Cowboys' team lead.

Green Bay has also been linked to Sweat, but the Packers now have Micah Parsons on their own defense. Nothing is finalized before the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

Dallas sits at 2-4 with a 25th-ranked defense and is tied for the second-fewest sacks in the NFL since trading Micah Parsons. Sweat, 29, a former Super Bowl champion, asked Arizona for a trade this offseason and was denied. Now he may get moved anyway, on someone else's timeline.
